description: 100 fictional expansion programs for a college basketball game. Append the teams to the existing teams array and add the 10 conference entries to the game's conference list.
baseDatabase: NCAA D1 2025 preseason database (365 original teams)
integrationNotes: These are fictional expansion programs; their imgURL is null so the game should show an abbreviation/initials fallback or assign custom logos.
Team IDs are 365-464 and conference IDs are 31-40, assuming the original database has 365 teams and conference IDs 0-30.
Append each object in teams to the original database's teams array.
Add each conference object to the active conference list in gameAttributes.confs[].value (or your game's equivalent).
Each team includes cbbGameData with gameplay ratings and flavor fields; the original Basketball GM engine may ignore unknown custom fields.
